title: mbar Energia - Mecânico de Manutenção (Usina Termelétrica)
description:
Job description

Somos a Âmbar, a empresa de geração e comercialização de energia do grupo J&F, o maior grupo privado do Brasil. Nosso amplo portfólio de ativos contribui para a expansão e diversificação da matriz energética do Brasil.

Temos 39 unidades de geração de energia, essenciais para a segurança no abastecimento de eletricidade. Nossas usinas fortalecem a transição energética sustentável para o país e para os nossos clientes. Somos o quarto maior gerador de energia a gás natural do Brasil em capacidade instalada. Possuímos ainda unidades hidrelétricas, solares, a biomassa, a carvão mineral e a biogás.

Respaldados pela solidez do grupo J&F, atuamos na comercialização de energia no Mercado Livre e em projetos de Geração Distribuída para clientes em todo o Brasil. Atuamos na gestão completa das contas, criando soluções personalizadas para consumidores e empresas de todos os portes.

Presente em mais de 190 países e com 70 anos de história, o grupo J&F tem um portfólio amplo de empresas. Entre elas estão a JBS, líder global em alimentos à base de proteína, além da Eldorado Brasil Celulose, J&F Mineração, Flora Higiene e Cosméticos, Picpay, Banco Original e Canal Rural.

Estamos em busca de um Mecânico que irá executar a manutenção mecânica preventiva, preditiva e corretiva em todos os equipamentos da usina, conforme as ordens de serviços de manutenção originadas pelo programa anual de manutenção, bem como as solicitações das ocorrências diárias de manutenção, com o intuito de atingir as metas de disponibilidade dos equipamentos.

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar as manutenções, preventiva, corretiva e preditiva de guisa segura, em equipamentos mecânicos tais como: turbina a gás e vapor, geradores e sistemas auxiliares, ETA, ETE, planta de desmineralização e de tratamento de óleo, compressores, válvulas, bombas, filtros, trocadores de calor, caldeiras HRSG, utilizando a de referência do plano de manutenção e das ordens de serviços, com o propósito de evitar problemas que causem paralização dos equipamentos e respectivamente da produção;
  • Preditiva, analisar e diagnosticar possíveis problemas em equipamentos, através de relatórios conclusivos, obtendo o diagnóstico em questão, a fim da tomada de decisão para resolução;
  • Analisar e medir as vibrações mecânicas nos equipamentos da usina, identificando folgas, desalinhamento das engrenagens dos mesmos, a fim de realizar reparos necessários;
  • Realizar análise de temperaturas dos equipamentos e identificar possíveis motivos de sobrecarga nos mesmos, a fim de sugerir a intervenção de manutenção devida para solucionar o problema;
  • Executar o plano de lubrificação mensal dos equipamentos, seguindo uma rota sequencial para este trabalho, a fim de evitar paralisações dos equipamentos causando prejuízos;
  • Garantir a qualidade dos serviços de manutenção prestados, através da obediência aos procedimentos da organização, a fim de manter a excelência dos resultados;
  • Auxiliar a melhoria contínua dos sistemas, através da implementação de projetos e modificações de rotinas e equipamentos, a fim de obter uma otimização rumo aos resultados;
  • Garantir a melhoria contínua da gestão de saúde, segurança, meio ambiente e social, seguindo a política de SSMA da empresa, reportando acidentes potenciais (quase acidentes, atos e condições inseguras), participando de reuniões e treinamentos de SSMA e tomando medidas que visem atenuar os riscos à saúde e segurança dos colaboradores e contratados em potencias impactos ambientais.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Médio/Técnico em Manutenção Mecânica ou Eletromecânica;
  • Necessário experiência em manutenção industrial em usinas térmelétricas;
  • Desejável conhecimento em Geradores de Energia, Turbina a Gás e Turbina a Vapor;
  • Conhecimento em Pacote office (Word e Excel);
  • NR10 e o SEP (Sistema Elétrico Potencia);
  • Ferramentaria e Equipamentos de Oficina (Torno, Esmeril e Prensa);
  • Conhecimento em Mecânica Industrial;
  • Conhecimento em Caldeira HRSG;
  • Conhecimento em Hidráulica e Pneumática;
  • Conhecimento de Alinhamento a Laser;
  • Conhecimento em Lubrificação;
  • Conhecimento em Análise de vibração;
  • Capacitação/Habilitação para operação de empilhadeira;
  • Interpretação de Desenho Mecânico.

Linux devices software engineer - snapd

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems, with Ubuntu widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. We are hiring a Linux devices software engineer on the SnapD team to work on mission‑critical Golang code focused on software delivery, containers, security sandboxing, telemetry and device management.

Snaps are next‑generation software packaging and delivery for Linux, designed for safety, security and robustness, with application‑specific confinement of containers optimized for IoT devices, desktops and servers. Our goal is to ensure snaps work across multiple Linux flavours so publishers have the simplest way to reach the whole Linux world.

We look for candidates who obsess over quality and performance at the heart of the operating system, are passionate about open source software development, and value collaboration, peer reviews, good unit/integration testing and maintainable code. General knowledge and experience with Linux as a developer platform is required; previous experience with Golang is highly desirable.

Location

This role will be based remotely in the EMEA or Americas regions.

Role responsibilities

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code to create new features
  • Debug Linux system‑level issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Obsess over achieving robustness despite unexpected events such as power outages
  • Work from home with global travel up to two weeks, twice a year

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills, are thoughtful and self‑motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have professional software development experience using Go, Python, C, or C++
  • You know Linux system‑level fundamentals, e.g. cgroups, namespaces, apparmor
  • Commitment to software testing, code reviews and maintainable code

What we offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review; performance‑driven annual bonus or commission
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Family leave (maternity and paternity leave) and Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the publisher of Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company.

Equal‑Opportunity Employer

Canonical is an equal‑opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

You'll improve pipelines built on Arrow/Parquet, ensure zero-copy and memory-safe operations, and build profiling, debugging, and stress-testing frameworks. The role requires close collaboration with data engineering, DevOps, and platform teams to ensure scalability, stability, and observability across the entire system.

What You'll Do:

  • Design and optimize large‑scale data processing systems, ensuring safe concurrency, efficient memory usage, and high performance with Python and C++.
  • Improve and integrate pipelines based on columnar formats such as Arrow and Parquet, ensuring zero‑copy, type consistency, and optimized I/O performance.
  • Build, profile, and debug critical components using low‑level tools such as gdb, valgrind, perf, and sanitizers to detect and resolve race conditions, memory leaks, and performance bottlenecks.

What we are looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience working with concurrent systems and large‑scale data processing.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, including multiprocessing, threading, and shared_memory.
  • Strong experience with modern C++ (C++17+).
  • Advanced knowledge in IPC and shared memory (shm_open, mmap), synchronization and safe concurrency strategies, and Python ↔ C++ interoperability (ctypes, pybind11, numpy.ctypeslib).
  • 3+ years of cloud experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience with columnar data and high‑performance formats including Apache Arrow, Parquet, and pyarrow/numpy (contiguity, dtypes).
  • Proficient with debugging and profiling tools such as perf, valgrind, gdb/lldb, sanitizers (ASAN/UBSAN), py-spy, and tracemalloc.
  • Strong understanding of memory management, efficiency, zero‑copy, and alignment.
  • Experience with stress and integration testing to detect race conditions, memory leaks, and concurrency failures.
  • Experience integrating observability tools such as Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, and structured logging.
  • Advanced proficiency in English.

Espera-se colaboração contínua com o time para revisão técnica de módulos, troca de conhecimento, melhoria de processos e adoção de novas tecnologias, sempre com foco na construção de produtos de segurança de alto impacto.

Rust Engineering Lead – Linux and Open Source

We are hiring Rust Engineering Leads of all levels of experience to drive the adoption of this exciting language into the full range of Canonical offerings, starting with Ubuntu but also our own projects and open source offerings. We also want to ensure that Ubuntu is the very best platform for Rust development, offering easy access to the widest range of tooling and capabilities that support cutting edge open source and enterprise development. This role will help keep Ubuntu the best platform for developers wanting to write Rust code for the full 99% of our user base.

After the first round of interviews we'll find the best fit product team at Canonical for you to progress your application based on your personal interests. We expect the highest engineering standards and strong motivation to get things done well in a fully home‑based and distributed environment.

A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia‑Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores

  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro de Segurança do Trabalho que será responsável por contribuir com a gestão de saúde e segurança da empresa, incluindo identificação, mensuração e proposta para mitigação dos riscos de saúde e segurança nos projetos e obras da NTS.

Responsabilidades

  • Desdobrar a Política de Sustentabilidade da NTS com o objetivo assegurar o cumprimento com os valores de respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente da empresa.
  • Contribuir para melhoria contínua do Sistema de Gestão Integrada da NTS por meio da revisão de procedimentos de SSMA, contribuir para implementação dos processos nos projetos com o objetivo de diminuir o número de incidentes na empresa.
  • Propor diretrizes de gerenciamento de riscos de Saúde e Segurança, contribuir com a implementação das ferramentas de risco da NTS (AR, LPR, PT, etc), para diminuir os cenários de risco de processo alto e muito alto, prevenindo a ocorrência de incidentes.

Localidade: Rio de Janeiro, RJ, Brasil

Horário de Trabalho: Administrativo

Tipo de Contrato: Indeterminado

Período de inscrição: de 05/01/2026 a 11/01/2026

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação superior em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Direito e/ou áreas correlatas.
  • Vivência em apuração de denúncias, fraudes e compliance.
  • Atuação em auditorias com conhecimento do Modelo de Linhas de Defesa.
  • Prática em revisão e melhorias de processos, gestão de riscos e implementação e/ou execução de controles.
  • Bons conhecimentos no Pacote Office.
  • Exclusivo para PcD (Pessoas com deficiência).

Requisitos Desejados

  • Inglês Intermediário.
  • Conhecimento em conceitos e diretrizes relacionadas a Direitos Humanos, Diversidade e/ou requisitos de Saúde e Segurança.
  • Habilidade em ERP e em ferramentas de apuração (ex.: Relativity, Nuix, e-Discovery Premium da Microsoft e outros).

Responsabilidades

  • Executar as atividades de análise, direcionamento de reclamações e apuração das denúncias que cabem ao próprio Canal de Denúncia.
  • Apurar, com base nos procedimentos definidos, efetuando levantamento e compilação de dados, verificações e demais análises, contribuindo com o cumprimento dos prazos e o atendimento aos padrões de qualidade definidos.
  • Operar, garantindo excelência nas apurações e promovendo o ambiente ético e transparente dentro da empresa;
  • Atuar com foco nas diretrizes relacionadas a Direitos Humanos, Diversidade e/ou requisitos de Saúde e Segurança;
  • Atuar em reclamações, apurações de casos de relações interpessoais, fraudes e outros; gerar informações tempestivas e atualizadas, com bom nível de análise e utilizando modelo mental quantitativo;
  • Garantir a elaboração, pelas áreas envolvidas, de planos de ação baseados nas denúncias (reclamações ou similares) recebidas, de forma que o Canal de Denúncias auxilie no trabalho de identificação de melhorias de controles, processos, sistemas e outros, trabalhando de forma preventiva, sempre buscando a redução efetiva das denúncias;
  • Mantener-se permanentemente atualizado acerca das principais regulamentações e práticas de mercado no tocante aos assuntos, regras e regulamentos relacionados à ética e conduta e os demais assuntos que possam estar relacionados à sua atividade no Canal de Denúncia;
  • Gerar informações qualificadas e estruturadas para os diversos stakeholders do Canal de Denúncia, a se destacar: Conselho de Administração, Conselho Fiscal, Diretoria Executiva, Liderança em Geral e comunicados gerais à companhia.

Benefícios

  • Previdência Privada
  • PLR - Programa de Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Reembolso Creche ou Auxílio Babá para empregadas
  • Assistência Médica e Hospitalar, odontológica, farmacológica e vacinas para prevenção de doenças Infectocontagiosas
  • PASA - Plano de Saúde para familiares de empregados ou para o próprio empregado, em caso de aposentadoria ou desligamento
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo
  • Auxílio funeral
  • Apoio - Programa de Assistência ao Empregado e seus dependentes.
  • Vale alimentação
  • Vale refeição ou Refeições no trabalho concedidas em restaurantes industriais
  • Vale alimentação extra para o Natal
  • Cartão presente no final do ano para Dependentes, filhos, enteados e menores sob guarda com até 10 anos
  • Transporte fretado ou Vale transporte.
  • Incentivo à atividade física - Wellhub
  • Programa Bem-Estar
  • Passagens no trem de passageiros na Estrada de Ferro Vitória a Minas (EFVM) e/ou na Estrada de Ferro Carajás (EFC).
  • Desconto para aluguel de carros

Sobre a Vale

Juntos, a gente transforma o futuro. A Vale tem uma história de transformação. Na mineração, atuamos para transformar recursos naturais em prosperidade e desenvolvimento sustentável. Na segurança, buscamos aprender com o passado para evoluir diariamente e se tornar referência de confiabilidade.

Acreditamos que a mineração é essencial para o desenvolvimento do mundo e precisamos deixar um legado para o meio ambiente, para as comunidades em que estamos e para todas as vidas que tocamos.

A Vale Metais Básicos é uma líder mundial em produção de minerais críticos para a produção de um futuro mais verde. Somos mais de 15 mil empregados ao redor do mundo, transformando minerais em prosperidade e desenvolvimento sustentável.

O jeito de ser da Vale: a gente transforma o minério, a gente transforma o país, porque o mais importante, para nós, são as pessoas. Sem elas, não vamos conseguir alcançar o futuro que a gente quer. Esse é o jeito de ser da Vale, a nossa razão de existir: melhorar a vida e transformar o futuro.

Instruções de candidatura

A Vale não realiza nenhum tipo de cobrança para participação em nenhuma etapa dos seus processos seletivos.

Todas as candidaturas devem ser feitas exclusivamente pelo nosso site ou por meio de vagas postadas no perfil da Vale no LinkedIn.

Legal e Inclusão

Todos os candidatos serão avaliados pela medicina da Vale Metais Básicos para confirmação do enquadramento em relação à Lei de Cotas para Pessoas com Deficiência (8.213/91). O que realmente importa é trabalhar com gente que quer fazer as coisas acontecerem. Queremos protagonistas, alguém que quer sempre aprender, correr atrás dos seus objetivos, gosta de desafios e tem um espírito colaborativo.

Você sabe a diferença entre diversidade e inclusão? Diversidade significa ter, no ambiente de trabalho, pessoas de todas as raças, credos, cores, religiões, culturas, orientações sexuais, características físicas. Inclusão é dar real espaço para todas as pessoas se desenvolverem na carreira, com equidade e oportunidades para qualquer cargo. Trabalhamos para construir um ambiente em que todos e todas se sintam aceitos e respeitados. Todas as oportunidades estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitados do INSS.

  • Step 3: Entrevista com Time de Gestão de Pessoas e Gestor da área 3 Entrevista com Time de Gestão de Pessoas e Gestor da área

Fundada em 20 de agosto de 1972, a Unimed do Estado do Rio de Janeiro – Federação Estadual das Cooperativas Médicas (Unimed Ferj) atua há 52 anos como representante estatutária de todas as Unimeds do estado. Ao longo de sua trajetória, a Unimed Ferj tem desempenhado um papel fundamental na promoção da conformidade regulatória e na implementação das melhores práticas de gestão entre as cooperativas do sistema Unimed no Rio de Janeiro.

Com uma governança corporativa voltada para a sustentabilidade e uma cultura organizacional focada em pessoas, a Unimed Ferj é uma referência no Sistema Unimed fluminense, que gera aproximadamente 16 mil empregos diretos e conta com uma ampla rede credenciada. Esses fatores contribuem para que o Sistema Unimed seja reconhecido como referência em Saúde Suplementar no Brasil.

Na função de Operadora de plano de saúde, a Unimed Ferj se dedica a oferecer um atendimento de excelência a mais de 470 mil clientes, por meio de uma ampla rede de médicos cooperados, unidades próprias e serviços credenciados.

Desde abril de 2024, a Unimed Ferj assumiu a gestão, o dimensionamento estrutural e o direcionamento assistencial do Hospital Unimed e dos Prontos Atendimentos Unimed na cidade do Rio de Janeiro. Nas unidades próprias, são mais de 2.400 profissionais comprometidos e dedicados a oferecer um cuidado humanizado e de excelência aos nossos pacientes.

Buscamos pessoas que valorizam as relações humanas e abraçam novas oportunidades. Na Rede Própria da Unimed Ferj, promovemos a diversidade, respeitamos diferentes ideias e perspectivas, e vivemos os princípios do cooperativismo, sempre com foco na excelência do cuidado.

description:
The Office of the Bursar at Howard University is seeking an experienced and strategic Assistant Bursar to lead cross‑functional business process improvement, systems optimization, and strategic student financial initiatives.

Basics

This senior leadership position serves as a key advisor to the AVP for Finance and University Bursar, ensuring that student financial operations, programs and initiatives are optimal, efficient, student‑centered, and aligned with University goals for financial sustainability, compliance, and student success.

Nature & Scope

The Assistant Bursar will provide leadership in evaluating and optimizing student financial business processes and systems, partner with the Director of Student Account Operations in spearheading the stabilization and enhancement of Workday Student Financials, build strong partnerships with Enrollment Management, Registrar, Financial Aid, IT, and Student Affairs to ensure coordinated delivery of financial services, and represent the Office of the Bursar in high‑level cross‑functional initiatives.

Principal Accountabilities

Leadership & Representation

  • Support and represent the AVP for Finance and University Bursar in cross‑functional committees, working groups, and University forums.
  • Provide strategic leadership in student financial services, with a focus on analysis, process improvement, and service excellence.
  • Manage and mentor staff to support functional analysis, process mapping, and system optimization.

Business Process Analysis & Strategy

  • Lead evaluation and improvement of student financial processes to enhance efficiency, compliance, and the student experience.
  • Align business processes and initiatives with institutional goals for enrollment, retention, and financial performance.
  • Translate strategic objectives into actionable business requirements and process improvements.

Systems & Data Optimization

  • Partner with the Director of Student Account Operations in the optimization of the Workday Student financial modules, ensuring functionality enhances student user experience and success and strengthens receivables and student account management.
  • Collaborate with IT and campus partners to address system gaps, refine workflows, and enhance usability.
  • Leverage data analytics and reporting to inform decision‑making and track progress toward financial and operational goals.

Strengthen Receivables Outcomes and Performance

  • Partner with the AVP to design and implement strategies that strengthen receivables management, reduce bad debt, and improve cash flow.

title: Roaming IREG Engineer - Lisbon-based
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world’s leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL’s evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (“MVNO”) in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world‑class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.

Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail-oriented RoamingIREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services.

We’re looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates.

This is a Lisbon‑based position, and relocation will be required. Relocation support may be provided for the selected candidate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards.
  • Set up and verify interconnect links for voice and messaging services with partner operators.
  • Monitor roaming service KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with roaming agreements.
  • Configure and test SS7, Diameter, SIP, and related signaling protocols for international connectivity.
  • Liaise with foreign operators, roaming hubs, and internal teams during implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date test results, network configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team.

Must Have

  • Perform end‑to‑end roaming testing (voice, SMS, data, CAMEL, VoLTE, 5G roaming).
  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs.
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems.
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21).
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services).
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc.) during testing and troubleshooting.
  • Validate TAP files and charging/billing aspects of roaming services.
  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch.
  • Follow‑up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service.
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers.
  • Have successful partnerships with other departments and teams.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills.
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape

What we offer?

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast‑paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting‑edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results‑driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

Mindrift is looking for passionate freelance contributors to join the Tendem project ( to help build the future of hybrid agents — where human expertise and AI capabilities work hand in hand. As an AI Agent Assistant, you'll collaborate with large language models (LLMs) that handle repetitive tasks, while you bring the nuance, judgment, and creativity required to deliver high‑quality results. In this role, you won’t just review what AI produces — you’ll work alongside it, shaping and completing outputs so they are accurate, reliable, and ready for real‑world application. Your day‑to‑day may range from fact‑checking a scientific claim to curating a dataset, conducting market research, or refining sales leads. Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

  • Skilled in web searching, fact‑checking, intent‑checking, able to work with LLMs and have great attention to detail.

  • Ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly, and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines.
  • Fully remote: you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available, and enthusiasm to take on a challenge.

Benefits

Fundada em 20 de agosto de 1972, a Unimed do Estado do Rio de Janeiro – Federação Estadual das Cooperativas Médicas (Unimed Ferj) atua há 52 anos como representante estatutária de todas as Unimeds do estado. Ao longo de sua trajetória, a Unimed Ferj tem desempenhado um papel fundamental na promoção da conformidade regulatória e na implementação das melhores práticas de gestão entre as cooperativas do sistema Unimed no Rio de Janeiro.

Com uma governança corporativa voltada para a sustentabilidade e uma cultura organizacional focada em pessoas, a Unimed Ferj é uma referência no Sistema Unimed fluminense, que gera aproximadamente 16 mil empregos diretos e conta com uma ampla rede credenciada. Esses fatores contribuem para que o Sistema Unimed seja reconhecido como referência em Saúde Suplementar no Brasil.

Na função de Operadora de plano de saúde, a Unimed Ferj se dedica a oferecer um atendimento de excelência a mais de 470 mil clientes, por meio de uma ampla rede de médicos cooperados, unidades próprias e serviços credenciados.

Desde abril de 2024, a Unimed Ferj assumiu a gestão, o dimensionamento estrutural e o direcionamento assistencial do Hospital Unimed e dos Prontos Atendimentos Unimed na cidade do Rio de Janeiro. Nas unidades próprias, são mais de 2.400 profissionais comprometidos e dedicados a oferecer um cuidado humanizado e de excelência aos nossos pacientes.

Buscamos pessoas que valorizam as relações humanas e abraçam novas oportunidades. Na Rede Própria da Unimed Ferj, promovemos a diversidade, respeitamos diferentes ideias e perspectivas, e vivemos os princípios do cooperativismo, sempre com foco na excelência do cuidado.

title: Program Officer
description:
IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING APPLICATION DEADLINE

please notice that the deadline for applications is indicated in local time as per the time zone of the applicant’s location.

This post is a limited-term fixed-term post.

1. Organizational Context

a. Organizational Setting

The post is located in the WIPO Brazil Office (WBO).

The WBO is part of a network of WIPO External Offices that add clear value, efficiency and effectiveness to the delivery of WIPO's programs, in line with its Strategic Goals and Results Framework, in a coordinated and complimentary way with WIPO Headquarters.

The WBO assists the Brazilian government, IP professionals, creators, innovators, businesses and communities in Brazil create value from IP through the use of WIPO treaties, services and global databases, platforms, tools, and products, as well as through the design and implementation of impactful projects and initiatives on the ground. The WBO also works to increase awareness on the importance of strengthening the Brazilian IP and Innovation ecosystem for economic, social and cultural development.

b. Purpose Statement

The Program Officer is responsible for providing technical guidance and supporting the development and implementation of project-based initiatives for Brazil. The Program Officer is responsible for ensuring close liaison and cooperation with the Brazilian authorities and other stakeholders in the country to extend the reach and impact of WIPO's support at the national, institutional and community level. The Program Officer also supports the Director of the WBO in ensuring the efficient and effective operations and management of the Office and its close and integrated functioning with WIPO Headquarters.

c. Reporting Lines

The Program Officer works under the supervision of the Director of the WBO.

d. Work Relations

The Program Officer liaises closely with Sectors, Divisions and work units in Headquarters, in particular with the Department of Development Cooperation and the Division for External Offices Coordination, connecting WIPO's cooperation assistance modalities, services, databases, tools, platforms and products with beneficiaries in Brazil in a coordinated, effective and efficient manner.

2. Duties and Responsibilities

  • Research and analyze specific data on how IP could support the development priorities for Brazil, identify new project opportunities, formulate and present project proposals providing technical and substantive input, and manage and monitor the administrative and operational activities of approved projects.
  • Design and implement capacity building programs and activities providing financial and technical support for such initiatives, coordinate with different sectors within the Organization and with external stakeholders and partners.
  • Engage with the Brazilian authorities and key national stakeholders (such as business associations, universities and research institutions, professional associations and representative bodies, civil society, innovators and creators) to design and implement projects and activities that address national needs across the country.
  • Liaise with United Nations institutions in Brazil on matters of common system interest to build synergies for mandate implementation.
  • Represent WIPO at national meetings and participate in missions and briefings to identify opportunities for and further mandate implementation.
  • Prepare reports and documents, including performance updates, progress on mandate implementation, financial results, as well as internal memoranda, draft agreements and other working documents to support reporting requirements.
  • Promote WIPO’s strategies and plans that would ensure greater and more effective use of WIPO’s Global IP services through targeted outreach to existing and potential users and establishment of partnerships.
  • Assist in the administration and management of the Office, including contributing to the monitoring of financial flows in line with organizational rules and regulations.
  • Perform other related duties as required.

3. Requirements

Education (Essential)

First-level university degree in law, economics, international relations, development studies or a related field.

Education (Desirable)

Advanced university degree in the above fields or a specialization in IP.

Experience (Essential)

  • At least six years' relevant professional experience in intellectual property, including copyright and creative economy.
  • Experience in project design and management.
  • Experience working with the Brazilian IP, innovation, and creative ecosystem.
  • Professional experience in international cooperation programs.

Language (Essential)

Excellent knowledge of written and spoken Portuguese and English.

Language (Desirable)

Knowledge of other UN language preferably Spanish.

Job Related Competencies (Essential)

  • Competent understanding and use of RBM frameworks in planning, monitoring, and evaluating projects and programmatic activities.
  • Ability to coordinate full project/program lifecycles, including administration of budget and financial resources.
  • Strong analytical thinking, organizational abilities, and planning skills, with a focus on effective progress tracking and reporting.
  • Strong digital literacy and adaptability in using a wide range of tools and platforms.
  • Excellent diplomatic skills and ability to work with tact and discretion.
  • Excellent drafting skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to foster and maintain effective partnerships and working relations in a multi-cultural environment and with a variety of stakeholders with sensitivity and respect for diversity.
  • Ability to work with limited supervision and take initiative while respecting Organizational regulations and rules.
  • Familiarity with IP concepts, including copyright and industrial property, and their relevance in project contexts.

Job Related Competencies (Desirable)

  • Good understanding of WIPO’s international registration systems.

4. Organizational Competencies

  • Communicating effectively.
  • Showing team spirit.
  • Demonstrating integrity.
  • Valuing diversity.
  • Producing results.
  • Showing service orientation.
  • Seeing the big picture.
  • Seeking change and innovation.
  • Developing yourself and others.

5. Information

Mobility

WIPO staff members are international civil servants subject to the authority of the Director General and may be assigned to any activities, office or duty station of the Organization. Accordingly, the selected candidate may be required to move from time to time to new functions and/or to another duty station.

Annual Salary

National Professional Officers (NPOs) are recruited locally in the country of the duty station. NPO shall normally be nationals of the country of the duty station.

Annual salary: 368,837 BRL (Total Net)

Salaries and allowances are paid in local currency. Please refer to WIPO’s Staff Regulation and Rules for detailed information concerning salaries, benefits and allowances.

Additional Information

The selected candidate’s appointment will be subject to an overall term of five years in this position, with normally no possibility of renewal beyond that term. S/he may, however, apply and be considered for other positions at WIPO.
  • This is not applicable to WIPO staff members on fixed-term, continuing or permanent appointments, who were recruited following a competition under Staff Regulation 4.10 (“Appointment Boards”).
  • This vacancy announcement may be used to fill other posts at the same grade with similar functions in accordance with Staff Rule 4.9.5.
  • Applications from qualified women as well as from qualified nationals of unrepresented Member States of WIPO and underrepresented geographical regions are encouraged.
